title: The Falling City Surreal Short Film
description: A cinematic surreal video prompt for Seedance 2.0 where a city falls upward around a stationary man, using high-end ARRI Alexa camera specifications.
promptText: THE FALLING CITY 15 second premium cinematic surreal short film, vertical 9:16 format, 8 scenes, one calm man standing still while the entire city slowly falls upward around him. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, Panavision anamorphic lens, natural film grain, subtle lens flares, moody blue-hour color grade with warm window light accents, photorealistic, not CGI. No text no words no letters anywhere on screen. SCENE 1 (0-2s): Close-up, a young man in a long dark coat stands on a city street at blue hour, eyes closed, completely calm, a single leaf beside his shoulder beginning to drift upward instead of falling. Camera: locked close-up. Motion speed: near still, only the leaf rising. SCENE 2 (2-4s): Around him, loose papers, umbrellas and street dust begin floating gently upward into the vertical sky, pedestrians' scarves lifting. Camera: slow tilt up following the rising objects through the tall frame. Motion speed: dreamlike slow motion. SCENE 3 (4-6s): A parked car slowly lifts off the asphalt, rotating gently as it rises past glowing apartment windows, water dripping upward from its body. Camera: vertical crane following the car up the face of the building. Motion speed: majestic slow motion. SCENE 4 (6-8s): Wide vertical shot, entire streetlights, benches and kiosks peeling off the ground and ascending in a slow procession up the canyon of skyscrapers, warm windows glowing as they pass. Camera: locked low angle looking up, the full vertical frame filled with rising city. Motion speed: serene and hypnotic. SCENE 5 (8-10s): The man opens his eyes, still standing firmly on the ground, his coat rippling upward, he looks up calmly at the ascending world. Camera: slow push-in on his face from below, rising debris drifting past the lens. Motion speed: real time face, slow motion surroundings. SCENE 6 (10-12s): Above him, cars and streetlamps drift among low clouds like a slow constellation, catching the last golden light, birds flying between the floating objects. Camera: tilt up from his shoulders to the sky-city above. Motion speed: weightless slow drift. SCENE 7 (12-13.5s): He takes one step forward, and with that single step everything pauses mid-air for a breath, the whole ascending city frozen in the vertical frame. Camera: locked wide vertical. Motion speed: complete suspended stillness, only his step in real time. SCENE 8 (13.5-15s): He continues walking calmly down the street as the frozen floating city hangs above him like chandeliers, one leaf drifting back down and landing on his shoulder. Camera: slow backward tracking in front of him, low angle keeping the floating city in the top of the frame. Motion speed: calm real time walk, loop-friendly ending. Movement: the world rising in continuous graceful slow motion while the man remains grounded and calm, fabric and hair gently lifting, objects rotating slowly as they ascend, one suspended pause as the emotional beat, his movements minimal and confident

promptText: A single uninterrupted cinematic shot begins at sunrise in the middle of a vast peaceful meadow. Wildflowers bloom across the meadow in waves of color. Butterflies flutter through the warm air while birds begin building nests among the branches. Soft morning mist lifts from the grass as sunlight grows brighter. Without stopping, the camera continues its orbit. The landscape gradually transforms into vibrant summer. The tree's canopy becomes dense and full. Long grass sways gently in the warm breeze. Bees collect pollen from blooming flowers. A nearby stream sparkles under intense sunlight. Children briefly appear beneath the tree enjoying a picnic before naturally fading as time continues moving forward. Everything feels alive with warmth and abundance. The camera never cuts. As it reaches the opposite side of the tree, summer slowly gives way to autumn. The sunlight becomes warmer and lower in the sky. Leaves transition through brilliant shades of emerald, yellow, orange, crimson, and deep red. Gentle wind carries thousands of leaves into elegant swirling patterns around the camera. The meadow changes into rich golden tones while migrating birds cross the distant horizon. Time accelerates. The final leaves drift gracefully to the ground. The orbit continues. A quiet snowfall begins. Within moments the landscape transforms into winter. Snow blankets every branch with delicate crystalline detail. Frost slowly spreads across the bark. The nearby stream freezes into clear ice. The sky becomes pale blue while soft snowflakes fall silently through the air. The entire world feels peaceful and still. The camera completes one full orbit. Instead of stopping, it continues circling faster. Each complete revolution now represents decades instead of seasons. Spring, summer, autumn, and winter flow continuously around the tree in increasingly rapid succession. Blossoms bloom and disappear. Leaves grow, change color, and fall. Snow arrives and melts.

promptText: First-person FPV drone shot diving into a frozen arctic canyon during a violent aurora storm. The drone rockets over cracked ice sheets, slips through glowing blue glacier tunnels, and banks between towering ice spires as green and violet aurora light ripples across every surface. The flight accelerates toward a colossal frozen waterfall suspended in midair. At the final moment, the waterfall shatters upward into millions of luminous ice fragments, revealing a hidden alien ocean beneath the glacier. The drone plunges through the floating ice debris and bursts underwater into a glowing bioluminescent abyss filled with giant drifting light forms. Seamless one-take, extreme FPV speed, realistic inertia, aggressive banking, cinematic motion blur, high-end VFX finale, volumetric mist, refractive ice, surreal scale, ultra-photorealistic, blockbuster ending, no cuts.
